title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Salary Negotiation
summary: Start salary negotiation this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Research the market band (Levels.fyi, Glassdoor)
2. Know your walk-away number
3. Let them name a number first if possible
4. Counter 10-20% above their offer
5. Negotiate the full package

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
facts: Let them name a number first if possible
